name: Renewables permitting deadlines in Greece
description: Producer Certificate filing cycles, deadlines for supplementary information, and the validity of the Final Connection Offer, the environmental terms decision (ΑΕΠΟ) and the Installation Licence, each with the provision that sets it.
creator: Ariadne Labs

rows.What: Cycle extension for a technical problem
Supplementary information for the Producer Certificate
rows.When: a set deadline fixed by the licensing body

rows.What: Supplementary information for the Final Connection Offer
rows.When: the operator asks within 20 days; the applicant has no less than 20 days to reply

rows.What: Validity of the Final Connection Offer
rows.When: three years, on the conditions of Law 5299/2026
rows.Provision: Law 4951/2022, art. 5(16), as replaced by Law 5299/2026, art. 14(2)

rows.What: Validity of the environmental terms decision (ΑΕΠΟ)
rows.Provision: Law 4014/2011, art. 2(8), as replaced by Law 4685/2020, art. 1(1)

rows.What: Timely application to renew the ΑΕΠΟ
rows.When: at least two months before expiry
three years, four for Special Projects
